description: This file is a TypeScript/JavaScript script that uses the TypeScript compiler API to analyze source code for specific function calls and enforce policies related to raw fetch calls in a plugin environment. It imports utility modules, defines a set of allowed call sites, and provides functions to identify 'fetch' calls and find their occurrences in source files.

methods.name: isRawFetchCall
methods.description: Checks if a given TypeScript AST expression is a raw fetch call, either 'fetch' or 'globalThis.fetch'.
